test_name: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring - CA-9 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Records-Service-034
Primary NIST family: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring (CA); evidence focus: CA-9.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: continuous monitoring collects security metrics and reports control status to system leadership. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
